text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 30, 2022) for 34 Dixington Crescent.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 30, 2022) for 34 Dixington Crescent, Folder Number: 22 234194 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to March 29, 2024.
